text: Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cottontail, who were good little bunnies, went down the lane to gather blackberries: But Peter, who was very naughty, ran straight away to Mr. McGregor's garden, and squeezed under the gate!
title: The Tale of Peter Rabbit — Page 3
director_note: The sisters gather and leave together down the lane, exiting left, while Peter is kept visually apart and only then runs to the gate. His squeeze and slide under the gate are clipped to the gate anchor and marked exiting, so no one remains in front of the gate.
